references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, donkeys are mentioned as part of the plunder, and here the total number of donkeys taken in the war against the Midianites is given.
Instructions on how the plunder, including donkeys, was to be distributed among the people and the Levites.
Part of the same count of war spoils, showing how the animals were distributed.
Donkeys are mentioned as valuable livestock and part of wealth in biblical times.
Donkeys are mentioned as part of gifts and wealth, demonstrating their value in ancient times.
